output_list.reason: The 'mintToken' function has an integer overflow attack vulnerability. When 'mintedAmount' is a large number, the 'totalSupply' += 'mintedAmount' operation will cause an overflow and set 'totalSupply' to a negative value, aka 'value' trap.

The 'transfer' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When '_value' is a large number, the 'balanceOf[_to] + _value > balanceOf[_to])' operation will cause an overflow and can be triggered to set 'balanceOf[_to]' to a large value, allowing attackers to manipulate balances.

The 'transferFrom' function has an integer overflow attack vulnerability. When '_value' is a large number, the 'balanceOf[_to] + _value > balanceOf[_to])' operation will cause an overflow and can be triggered to set 'balanceOf[_to]' to a large value, allowing attackers to manipulate balances.

The 'burn' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When 'mintedAmount' is a large number, the 'totalSupply -= _value' operation will cause an overflow and set 'totalSupply' to a negative value, aka 'value' trap.

The 'burnFrom' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When '_value' is a large number, the 'balanceOf[_from] -= _value' operation will cause an overflow and can set 'balanceOf[_from]' to a negative value, allowing attackers to manipulate balances.
